# Seven Nil

> Seven Nil is a free browser game. You draft a historic World Cup or club XI, then simulate the tournament. Ratings are for that season, not a career peak. Not affiliated with FIFA or UEFA.

Updated 24 September 2026. Contact: sagnik.dhar2018@gmail.com

## Play

- [World Cup draft](https://seven-nil-self.vercel.app/): Roll one nation and one tournament year, pick one player, fill eleven roles.
- [Club draft](https://seven-nil-self.vercel.app/club): Roll a top-five league club and a season from 1980 on.
- [Friends](https://seven-nil-self.vercel.app/friends): Pass-and-play, a final, or a seeded World Cup with real nations.
- [Club friends](https://seven-nil-self.vercel.app/club/friends): A rivalry or a UCL-style knockout. Separate from World Cup rooms.

## Guides

- [How to play](https://seven-nil-self.vercel.app/how-to-play): Roll, pick, place, and simulate, including penalties and friends cups.
- [About](https://seven-nil-self.vercel.app/about): Who makes the game, how a season rating is set, and what it is not.
- [Contact](https://seven-nil-self.vercel.app/contact): Email the maker. Online only. No phone and no office.

## Optional

- [Privacy](https://seven-nil-self.vercel.app/privacy): What stays on the device, and how ads work.
- [Terms](https://seven-nil-self.vercel.app/terms): The game is a simulation, not a forecast or a licensed product.
